text: Clara: quick sync on the invite modal UX — two linked asks: 1) make the org-level auth policy visible without implying per-invite control, 2) ensure admins can jump straight to recent invite events in the audit log after a batch. attached sketch in thread. Ethan: thanks — i experimented with three patterns: a) full toggle in header, b) small status badge that links to settings, c) short explanatory line under the title. my gut says option b is the least surprising. Rina: accessibility POV: toggle in modal header is risky. keyboard users can miss it unless tab order is carefully controlled. if we do a badge, it must be focusable, announceable, and have an aria-describedby to an offscreen explanation. also contrast needs to meet AA. Tom: engineering note easiest and most robust is a focusable anchor that deep-links into settings. example snippet: ``` SSO required ``` on navigate, settings page reads ?focus=sso and calls focus() on the SSO header. no inline toggle state in the modal. Clara: legal is explicit: no per-invite SSO override. so copy must reflect that. security prefers the verb "required". product wants the tone to not feel punitive. suggested visible copy: "SSO required" + tooltip: "Single sign-on is required for this organization. To change, go to Organization settings." Ethan: microcopy variants: shorter badge: "SSO required"; longer info: "SSO required — managed in Org settings". i'll mock both — the longer helps avoid surprise. Rina: aside from aria-describedby, tooltip content must be in DOM and keyboard togglable. when the badge link receives focus, we should provide a clear affordance to open the tooltip (Enter/Space). also add a hidden 'Skip to audit' link at top of modal for SR users who need to jump straight to the audit link. Tom: agreed. also will avoid scrolling animations when deep-linking; SRs need immediate focus. i'll add a ?from=invite-modal param so audit can show a small banner: "Viewing invite activity (recent batch)". sample audit deep link: /orgs/456/audit?filter=invites&from=invite-modal Clara: good. UX decision outcomes: 1) implement focusable badge left of modal title, 2) badge links to settings with ?focus=sso, 3) include tooltip with recommended copy, 4) footer link "Open invite activity" -> audit filter with from param, 5) append "sso_status: required" to batch audit events. Ethan: visual notes badge should be compact but not cramped on narrow viewports. propose min-width 72px, font 14px, padding 8px. info icon to open tooltip sits immediately after the badge. Rina: keyboard test plan: Tab order hits badge first, Enter opens tooltip, tooltip announced by screen reader, Tab continues into form fields, Footer audit link reachable before close. NVDA + VoiceOver checks required. also ensure aria-live not used for tooltip (prefer aria-describedby). Tom: i'll prototype HTML/CSS and a small JS module for deep-link focus and focus management. will include Cypress keyboard test and a short manual SR checklist. PipelineBot: build queued for branch feat/invite-policy-badge at 2145679100 https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/5555 Clara: perfect. plan: Tom -> push prototype to staging, run keyboard + SR checks, then 2-admin usability run. one last copy change from compliance: make audit field key exact string `sso_status: required` so downstream parsers are stable. Rina, confirm aria-label should match visible text? Rina: yes, match visible text to aria-label. add hidden description: 'Single sign-on is required for this organization; changes must be made in Organization settings.' Ethan: i'll drop updated PNGs in the thread after tweaking spacing for mobile. Tom: noted. ETA for PR by EOD. i'll link staging once deployed. Clara: thanks team :raised_hands:
